# Build order for src/css/zarvan.css
#
# This file is the single source of truth for stylesheet order. Order matters: the specificity contract
# documented at the top of the generated file relies on reset coming first and state coming last, and
# equal-specificity ties are resolved by source order.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Paths are relative to src/css/.

# --- reset: neutralise the host's base styles (lowest specificity, must come first) ---
parts/reset.css

# --- tokens: the whole theming surface ---
parts/tokens.css

# --- base: root box, typography, container declaration ---
parts/base.css

# --- layout: the shell around the active view ---
parts/layout/header.css
parts/layout/shell.css
parts/layout/scrollbars.css

# --- components: reusable widgets, no view knowledge ---
parts/components/menu-button.css
parts/components/nav.css
parts/components/dropdown.css
parts/components/filters.css
parts/components/autocomplete.css
parts/components/export-button.css
parts/components/mini-calendar.css
parts/components/modal.css
parts/components/now-indicator.css
parts/components/event.css

# --- views ---
parts/views/month.css
parts/views/week.css
parts/views/day.css
parts/views/timegrid.css
parts/views/allday.css
parts/views/year.css
parts/views/list.css

# --- state: must come after views so equal-specificity state rules win ---
parts/state.css

# --- responsive: container queries, last ---
parts/responsive.css
